items.title: Anthropic boss Dario Amodei calls for AI development to slow down
items.description: The call comes amid growing concerns that AI models may become able to inflict serious damage worldwide.

items.title: Saudi Arabia shuts key oil pipeline after drone attack launched from Iraq
items.description: Iraq removes a military commander and opens investigations into the attack that came from an area bordering Iran.

items.title: Trump's comments on a united Ireland may have targeted audience across the Atlantic
items.description: Nobody could have predicted that today's main global headline would be Trump's desire to see a unified Ireland.

items.title: Fire at nursing home in Chile kills 16 residents
items.description: Ten people were evacuated from the home in Araucanía region in central Chile.

items.title: French officials investigate if malicious act caused train derailment
items.description: Officials say a rail fragment was found on the tracks after Friday's crash of a passenger train that left 44 people injured.

items.title: Uganda's King Oyo buried amid calls for unity over his successor
items.description: A TV news presenter has been named as the traditional kingdom of Tooro's new monarch but the late king's family claim he chose an heir.

items.title: Ukraine faces 'toughest winter' since Russia's full-scale invasion, UN official tells BBC
items.description: A senior UN official tells the BBC there is a race against the clock to ensure access to power and water through winter.

items.title: Death toll from Philippines ferry fire rises to 76, with more still missing
items.description: Access to the burnt-out boat has been slowed by toxic fumes and lingering heat, the country's coast guard says.

items.title: Record heatwaves in France set to make champagne stronger
items.description: Winemakers can produce bubbly up to 15% ABV following an unusual harvest that produced sweeter grapes.

items.title: Only Roland Garros towel left, says Ukraine tennis player after Russian strike hits flat
items.description: Dayana Yastremska says her flat took a "direct hit" by a Russian missile in Odesa, and all that left was her Roland Garros towel.

items.title: Bulgaria investigates fire at weapons  site that owner calls sabotage
items.description: Officials are not ruling out "outside interference", while the company says the blaze at its site was sabotage.

items.title: Arrest made over the death of black woman found hanged from tree in Mississippi
items.description: Tasia Fortune's body was found  in the lot of an abandoned home in Mississippi in August.
